name: com.predictionmarketspicks/quant
title: PredictionMarketsPicks
description: Free to connect, no API key. Independent quant layer: EV, Kelly on Kalshi, Polymarket US, Novig

tools.name: fed_rate_odds
tools.description: Use for "will the Fed cut, hold or hike" and "next FOMC meeting odds". Live Kalshi odds for each remaining 2026 FOMC meeting: the next meeting's full strike breakdown and days-until, the rate path, the current fed funds rate, and a next-meeting cross-venue check against Polymarket and CME futures, with the gap in pp.

tools.name: calculate_ev
tools.description: Use for "is this contract mispriced" and "what is my edge". Give a Kalshi, Polymarket US or Novig price in cents and your own probability; returns the % expected-value edge and a BUY / SELL / SKIP read, with that venue's fee.

marketPrice.description: Current contract price in cents (1–99), equal to the implied probability in %. Required for a real answer. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

yourProbability.description: Your own estimate of the true probability the contract resolves YES, in % (0–100). Required for a real answer. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

venue.description: Where you would trade it: kalshi, polymarket-us or novig. Default kalshi. One of: kalshi · polymarket-us · novig.

novigMarket.description: With venue novig: pregame (default), live or futures. Sets the fee. One of: pregame · live · futures.

venuePrices.description: The same contract's price on each venue, in cents. Adds EV after each venue's fee and best_venue.

tools.name: kelly_size
tools.description: Compute the optimal Kelly position size for a Kalshi, Polymarket US or Novig contract. Given your win probability, the market price (which sets the payout), your bankroll, and a Kelly fraction (full / half / quarter / eighth), returns the dollar stake and a risk rating. Use for "how much should I stake", "what is my position size", "Kelly sizing for this trade".

venue.description: Where you would trade it: kalshi, polymarket-us or novig. Default kalshi. One of: kalshi · polymarket-us · novig.

novigMarket.description: With venue novig: pregame (default), live or futures. Sets the fee. One of: pregame · live · futures.

winProbability.description: Your probability the contract resolves YES, in % (0–100). Omit both this and marketPrice for the inputs and a worked example. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

marketPrice.description: Contract price in cents (1–99). Sets the payout ratio. Omit both this and winProbability for the inputs and a worked example. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

bankroll.description: Total bankroll in dollars (e.g. 1000). Optional — omit it and the result is the % of bankroll to stake, without a dollar figure.

fraction.description: Kelly fraction to apply. Half-Kelly is the common sharp-money default. One of: full · half · quarter · eighth.

tools.name: bayes_update
tools.description: Update a prior probability with one or more pieces of evidence using Bayes theorem. Given a prior and a list of evidence items (each with P(evidence | true) and P(evidence | false)), returns the posterior probability and the per-step chain. Use for "update my estimate with new information", "posterior probability", "how does this news change the odds".

prior.description: Prior probability the hypothesis is true, in % (0–100). Needed for a real answer. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

evidence.description: One or more evidence items, applied in order. Each item needs likelihoodIfTrue and likelihoodIfFalse on the 0–100 scale, e.g. [{ "likelihoodIfTrue": 80, "likelihoodIfFalse": 20 }].

label.description: Optional short caption for this evidence. Defaults to "Evidence 1", "Evidence 2", …

likelihoodIfTrue.description: P(observing this evidence | hypothesis is true), in % (0–100).

likelihoodIfFalse.description: P(observing this evidence | hypothesis is false), in % (0–100).

tools.name: convert_probability
tools.description: Convert between implied probability, American odds, and decimal odds. Give one value and its format and get all three back (American odds carry no commas, e.g. +441 or -200). Use for "what is +150 as a probability", "convert 62% to American odds", "decimal to implied odds".

value.description: The numeric value to convert. Needed for a real answer, with format.

format.description: Format of `value`: probability (0–100 %), american (e.g. -200 / +150), or decimal (e.g. 2.5). One of: probability · american · decimal.

tools.name: stress_test_strategy
tools.description: Paste a prediction-market trade history (or just trades, wins and average price) and get whether the edge is statistically real, how many trades would prove it, and where it leaks. The verdict reads net per dollar staked after fees, never a pooled win rate, with the bar raised for every strategy version tried. Accepts positions, a CSV, or Kalshi's realized P&L export (lots are grouped into positions). Nothing you paste is stored.

trades.description: EITHER an array of positions [{ price_c (1–99, price paid per contract), contracts?, won (true | false | null = closed before settlement, then give net_c), fee_c? (total fee, ¢), net_c?, at? (ISO), venue? (kalshi | polymarket | other), maker? }] OR, for a quick check, the number of trades (with wins and avg_price_c).

csv.description: CSV text instead of trades: header price_c,contracts,won,fee_c,at,venue,maker (one row per position), or Kalshi's realized P&L export. Up to 10,000 lines.

wins.description: Quick check: how many of the trades won.

avg_price_c.description: Quick check: average price paid per contract, ¢ (1–99).

venue.description: Venue for fees when none are given: kalshi (fee computed), polymarket or other (fee 0, flagged). One of: kalshi · polymarket · other.

maker.description: Quick check: maker fills (Kalshi maker fee).

strategies_tried.description: How many versions you tried before this one (default 1). More tries raise the bar (Bonferroni).

tools.name: base_rate_gap
tools.description: Use for "how does this price compare to history" and "is the market ignoring the base rate". Compares a market price with the historical base rate for a class of events: the gap in pp, a signal, and sample-size quality. Pass a known baseRateId (the parameter lists them) or your own baseRateValue.

marketPrice.description: Current market price in cents / implied probability % (0–100). Needed for a real answer. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

baseRateId.description: Known base-rate id to look up (includes sample size + source).

baseRateValue.description: Your own base rate in % (0–100), used when no baseRateId is given.

tools.name: combo_edge
tools.description: Use for "price a same-game NFL and NBA combo" and "is this combo worth it". Pass nflGame ("NYG-LAR", "Giants vs Rams") to list that game's Kalshi legs — moneyline, spreads, totals, player props — then legIds to price your pick with the correlation done for you. Or pass legPrices + trueWinProbability for a fair band; add offeredOdds for EV and a verdict. Free.

venue.description: Where you would trade it: kalshi, polymarket-us or novig. Default kalshi. One of: kalshi · polymarket-us · novig.

novigMarket.description: With venue novig: pregame (default), live or futures. Sets the fee. One of: pregame · live · futures.

legPrices.description: Each leg's YES price in cents (1–99). Omit with nflGame + legIds.

trueWinProbability.description: Your estimate that all legs hit, in % (0–100). Omit with nflGame + legIds — we compute it.

nflGame.description: An NFL game on the live board, as "AWAY-HOME" (e.g. "NYG-LAR"). Alone: lists its legs with ids, trimmed (narrow with player/stat/kind/limit). With legIds: prices that exact combo.

nbaGame.description: An NBA game on tonight's board, as "AWAY-HOME" (e.g. "BOS-DET"). Same doors as nflGame.

legIds.description: 2–6 leg ids from a previous nflGame call (array or comma-separated string).

player.description: With nflGame: every strike for a player whose name contains this (e.g. "Mariota").

stat.description: With nflGame: props of one stat (e.g. "rec_yds").

kind.description: With nflGame: "game" = all game lines, "prop" = props only. One of: game · prop.

limit.description: With nflGame: max props listed (default 40, max 200).

offeredOdds.description: The combo price you are quoted — American odds (-150, 988) or a decimal multiplier (10.7). Omit for fair value only.

offeredAmerican.description: Alias for offeredOdds; offeredOdds wins if both are sent.

tools.name: nfl_power_ratings
tools.description: The PredictionMarketsPicks NFL power ratings — PWR for all 32 teams: points per game above an average team on a neutral field, where PWR = Off PR + Def PR + ST PR. Includes each team's rank and tier. Use for "best NFL teams by power rating", "NFL power rankings 2026", "is Baltimore overrated", "how good is Kansas City", "NFL team ratings".

team.description: Optional team abbreviation (e.g. "KC", "SF", "LAR") — returns just that team's rating + rank.

tier.description: Optional tier: Elite (PWR ≥+7), Contender (≥+4), Playoff (≥+1), Average (≥−2), Below Avg (≥−5), Rebuild (<−5).

limit.description: Max teams to return, best rating first (default 32 = full board).

tools.name: nfl_win_probability
tools.description: Use for "who wins Chiefs vs 49ers" and "what does a -7 spread mean". Pass homeTeam + awayTeam (or game, or one team) for our QB-gated model line (raw power ratings if unscheduled), or a spread (home favored negative). Returns win, cover and over/under probability, the projected score and our own total; neutral-site games get no home edge.

spread.description: Point spread from the home team's perspective — home favored is NEGATIVE (e.g. -6.5). Provide this OR homeTeam+awayTeam.

total.description: Game total (over/under) you want tested, not our projection; defaults to the league average. Ours comes back as `model_total`.

homeTeam.description: Home team — abbrev (KC), nickname (Chiefs), full name (Kansas City Chiefs) or city (Kansas City) all work. Auto-derives the spread from PMP power ratings.

awayTeam.description: Away team — same formats as homeTeam (SF, 49ers, San Francisco 49ers). Used with homeTeam.

game.description: Or name the game in one string — "Bills vs Chiefs", "BUF@KC", "Buffalo at Kansas City". The schedule decides which side is home.

tools.name: find_arbitrage
tools.description: Use for "where is the arbitrage" and "Kalshi vs Polymarket price gaps". Cross-venue gaps on the same NFL, NBA, NHL or MLB game: Kalshi against Polymarket US (the exchange US traders use, fees included), Polymarket international as a reference. Gap in pp, WATCH/ARB signal, cheaper venue, settlement_match; near misses when nothing clears. Free: the top 3 gaps in full; Pro returns the whole board.

minGap.description: Minimum gap in percentage points to include (default 3 = WATCH threshold).

tools.name: market_pulse
tools.description: The US macro-health composite (0–100) and regime plus the six category scores (growth, labor, inflation, rates, liquidity, sentiment). Returns the composite, the regime call and 2 category scores without an account, 4 to a signed-in account, and all six with Pro. Use for "how is the US economy", "macro regime", "risk-on or risk-off".

topic.description: macro = the US macro-health composite (the only topic). One of: macro.

tools.name: commodity_edge
tools.description: Use for "gold edge today" and "oil or bitcoin trade signal". The Kalshi daily gold, silver or WTI strike, or hourly bitcoin strike, with the largest PMP model edge, as a ticket: side, entry price, resolve criterion, model probability, edge, tier and quarter-Kelly size. Pass tickers[] to check a watchlist. Pro — sign in with PredictionMarketsPicks, or a Pro API key.

commodity.description: Which commodity edge to read (needed for a real answer). One of: silver · bitcoin · gold · oil.

tickers.description: Optional Kalshi ticker watchlist (up to 25), market or event tickers. Unmodeled tickers return not_covered.

tools.name: edge_alerts
tools.description: Use for "any edge on Kalshi", "where is the edge today" and "weather trade signals". Our model alerts on Kalshi — weather, bitcoin/silver/gold/oil, mispricings — with feed, tier, side, price, model probability, edge and link. Real time with Pro; free is delayed 24h without the thesis. One identical, impersonal feed for every subscriber; filters only select. Informational, not investment advice.

feed.description: Comma-separated feeds to include: weather, bitcoin, silver, gold, oil, mispricing, sports_arb, nfl. Omit for all.

min_tier.description: Minimum confidence tier (returns that tier and above). One of: SPECULATIVE · MODERATE · STRONG.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only alerts created after it.

limit.description: Max alerts to return (default 25; 4 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: nfl_edge
tools.description: Use for "which NFL games are mispriced on Kalshi" and "NFL win total, MVP or Super Bowl edges". Our NFL model vs live Kalshi prices — this week's game positions, season win totals, MVP and championship odds: model probability, price, edge and side. tickers[] checks a watchlist (futures, mvp, championship). Pro — sign in with PredictionMarketsPicks, or a Pro API key.

market.description: game = this week; futures = win totals; mvp; championship = playoffs to Super Bowl. One of: game · futures · mvp · championship.

limit.description: Max rows (default 10; 5 when the call has no arguments).

tickers.description: Optional Kalshi ticker watchlist (up to 25), market or event tickers. Unmodeled tickers return not_covered.

tools.name: nfl_prop_edge
tools.description: Use for "best NFL props today" and "receiving yards prop value". Our projection vs the Kalshi "X or more" prop line: the contract, the YES/NO call, our odds and Kalshi's price for that side, the projection and the edge, with WATCH rows labelled. Live in season. Pro — sign in with PredictionMarketsPicks, or a Pro API key.

propType.description: Optional filter by prop type. One of: pass_yds · pass_tds · rush_yds · rec_yds · receptions · anytime_td.

limit.description: Max rows (default 10; 5 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: nhl_edge
tools.description: Use for "NHL predictions tonight" and "Stanley Cup odds". Tonight's NHL games on Kalshi — moneyline, puck line, totals, period markets — as Market · Model · Fair, starting goalies checked first. market=goals: anytime and first-goal contracts; market=futures: Cup, conference and division markets on Kalshi and Polymarket US (cost after fees) vs a 10,000-season sim. Free.

market.description: game = tonight's board; goals = player goals; futures = Stanley Cup and season markets. One of: game · goals · futures.

team.description: Optional NHL club to filter — code (CAR, EDM, LAK), Kalshi code (LA, TB), nickname ("Oilers") or city ("Edmonton").

limit.description: Max rows (default 16; 3 games without the contract list when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: nfl_prop_board
tools.description: Use for "where is the best price on <player> receiving yards" and "is Kalshi cheaper than the books". Best price on every NFL prop this week: Kalshi (fee included) vs five books (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, Fanatics, ESPN) and the Novig and ProphetX exchanges — the best price per side, how much cheaper Kalshi is than the books, the consensus gap, and the Kalshi close once a strike settles. Filter by team, game, player or stat.

team.description: Team abbrev (SEA, NE, LAR, JAX) — rows for that club only.

game.description: Game anchor away-home, e.g. "ne-sea" — rows for that game only.

statType.description: Optional prop type filter. One of: pass_yds · pass_tds · rush_yds · rec_yds · receptions · anytime_td.

gapsOnly.description: Only strikes where Kalshi and the consensus are 5¢+ apart (default false).

position.description: Optional position filter. One of: QB · RB · WR · TE.

limit.description: Max rows (default 15; 3 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: nba_prop_board
tools.description: Use for "where is LeBron's points line cheapest tonight". Every Kalshi NBA player-prop strike (points, rebounds, assists, threes) beside DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, Fanatics, ESPN, Novig and ProphetX at the same strike: the cheapest venue per side, Kalshi fee included. Market prices only, no model.

statType.description: Optional stat. One of: pts · reb · ast · threes.

limit.description: Max rows (default 15; 4 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: nba_game_board
tools.description: Use for "Knicks moneyline on Kalshi vs the books" and "cheapest place for the Celtics spread tonight". Kalshi NBA moneyline, spread and total beside DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, Fanatics, ESPN, Novig and ProphetX at the same line: the cheapest venue per side, Kalshi fee included. Market prices only, no model.

market.description: Optional market. One of: moneyline · spread · total.

limit.description: Max games (default 5; 2 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: nba_injury_impact
tools.description: Use for "Embiid's out tonight — who benefits?" and "who's out in the NBA today". Today's NBA absences from the official injury report, and for each absent star the teammates whose minutes, points, rebounds, assists and usage rose in past games without him (last two seasons, sample size on every row), beside today's Kalshi prop prices. Questionable players fork into plays/sits branches until ruled. Historical splits only, no projection.

player.description: The absent player, or a teammate to look up (partial name).

stat.description: Stat to rank beneficiaries by (default points). One of: pts · reb · ast · min · usg · fg3m · stl · blk.

tools.name: nfl_ladder
tools.description: Use for "where does the model disagree with Kalshi on the Rams spread" and "biggest ladder gaps this week". Every NFL strike ladder — spreads, season win totals, player props — with Kalshi's price at each strike beside our distribution and a SHAPE / LOCATION / PRICED / PARTIAL verdict. Our number is published only between 30% and 70%.

family.description: Ladder family. Omit for all three. One of: spread · season_wins · props.

team.description: Team abbrev (SEA, LAR, JAX) — ladders involving that club.

player.description: Player name (partial, case-insensitive) — prop ladders only.

kind.description: Verdict filter. One of: shape · location · agree · partial.

limit.description: Max ladders (default 8; 3, with the strikes around the widest gap, when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: ladder_arb
tools.description: Use for "is any NBA ladder mispriced tonight", "where can I make a market on Kalshi" and "does Novig or Polymarket US price this strike differently". Spread/total strikes priced out of order on Kalshi, Novig and Polymarket US across seven leagues — NFL, college football, NBA, NHL, men's college basketball, Premier League, Champions League: locked arbitrage, crossed-mid inversions on real two-sided books, wide books worth making a market in, and the same strike priced apart on two venues (cross = tradeable net of both venues' fees, gap = informational), with both ids and books, gross edge, liquidity, as-of and tier. Pro adds the resting orders, net-of-fee edge and quarter-Kelly size on Kalshi and Novig rows; Polymarket US rows are shown for information.

sport.description: cfb · nfl · nba · nhl · cbb · epl · ucl · all (default all; both = all).

signal.description: locked · inverted · wide · cross · gap · all (default all). cross/gap = the same strike on two venues.

min_edge.description: Minimum NET edge in cents (default 1). Accepts 2, "2c", "2".

min_volume.description: Minimum per-leg volume in dollars (default 20000). Accepts 20000, "$20,000".

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, max 100; 3 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: fifteen_min_board
tools.description: Use for "what is the ETH 15-minute market doing" and "which Kalshi 15-minute markets are open". Every Kalshi 15-minute up-or-down series (crypto, metals, energy, FX): window status, YES price, close time, target, settlement source and the up rate over the last 96 windows; the same window on Polymarket international for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP; and our live Bitcoin top-of-hour strategy with its record.

open_only.description: Only series with a window open right now (default false).

limit.description: Max rows (default 30; 4 when the call has no arguments).

horizon.description: 15m (Kalshi, default) or 5m (Polymarket US BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP; Kalshi lists none). One of: 15m · 5m.

tools.name: weather_board
tools.description: Use for "Kalshi NYC high temperature odds". Every open Kalshi daily-high strike in 13 cities: YES price, settlement station and source, the strict-comparison rule, close time, and the NWS forecast high beside it. Pass city ("nyc", "KXHIGHCHI"). Market data only.

city.description: City name or series ("nyc", "KXHIGHTBOS"). Omit for all.

tools.name: weather_settlement
tools.description: Use for "what will the Kalshi NYC high settle at", "has LAX already hit 75" and "which Polymarket temperature bucket is winning". Per station: the running max under each venue's settlement rule (Kalshi and Polymarket US on the NWS Climate Report; Polymarket.com on routine METARs), the observation that set it, the next report countdown, the strikes already decided and the official high once it lands. Pass station ("la", "KLAX"). Settlement data only, no picks.

station.description: Station or city ("la", "KLAX", "nyc", "KXHIGHCHI", "LGA"). Omit for every tracked station.

tools.name: track_record
tools.description: Use for "how accurate is your model" and "what's your track record". Every graded PredictionMarketsPicks signal per engine (bitcoin, gold, silver, oil, weather, NHL) and the daily editorial call (POTD): W-L, net P/L, a 95% win-rate range and the current model era, and the NFL model's 2026 live record (published game positions and prop PLAYs) beside its backtest. WATCH calls are reported apart.

lane.description: Optional lane: bitcoin, gold, silver, oil, weather, nhl, potd, nfl — or an engine slug. Omit for every lane; one lane adds its current model era.

tools.name: my_league
tools.description: Use for "show my fantasy team" and "what is Kalshi pricing my starters at". Give a Sleeper username (and a league name if you have several): your roster, each starter's opponent and kickoff, OUT and QB-gate flags, and every Kalshi prop strike on him this week with the best price per side. Market data; Pro adds our weekly projection.

sleeper_username.description: Sleeper username (profile → username, not the display name).

league.description: League name (partial) or Sleeper league id, when the user is in several.

tools.name: start_sit
tools.description: Use for "should I start Nacua or Adams" and "who does the market like more this week". For 2–4 players: the median Kalshi is pricing for each stat (read off his own strike ladder) and his anytime-TD price, compared on the stats they share. Market prices only — the call stays yours; Pro adds our weekly projection. Example: {"players": ["Puka Nacua", "Davante Adams"]} or {"players": "Nacua, Adams"}; more than four names compares the first four.

players.description: Two to four player names, e.g. ["Puka Nacua", "Davante Adams"] or "Nacua, Adams".

tools.name: waiver_targets
tools.description: Use for "who is everyone adding off waivers" and "trending waiver adds this week". Sleeper's most-added players in the last 24 hours with what Kalshi is pricing each at this week; pass position, and a Sleeper username + league to see only players still available. Market data only.

position.description: Optional position filter. One of: QB · RB · WR · TE.

sleeper_username.description: Sleeper username — with it, players already rostered in your league are left out.

league.description: League name (partial) or id, when the user is in several.

tools.name: perps_board
tools.description: Use for "Kalshi perps funding rate" and "how much leverage on Kalshi gold perps". Every Kalshi perpetual future: price, 24h volume, open interest, max leverage long and short, funding cadence, and what funding has cost a long since launch. Pass asset ("btc", "gold") for one.

limit.description: Max rows (default 25; 8 when the call has no arguments).

tools.name: perp_liquidation
tools.description: Use for "where does a 5x bitcoin long liquidate on Kalshi". Estimates a Kalshi perp's liquidation price and the % move to it from Kalshi's risk parameters (a 5x BTC long is about 8% away, not the 20% the 100÷leverage rule implies), plus fees and expected funding. An estimate; Kalshi's app shows the exact one. Assets: btc, eth, sol, xrp, doge, hype, link, gold, silver, platinum, palladium. Free.

leverage.description: Leverage, e.g. 5 or "5x". Capped at Kalshi’s maximum for the size and side.

hold_days.description: Days held, for the funding estimate (default 7).

tools.name: senate_map
tools.description: Use for "2026 Senate map" and "which Senate seats are toss-ups". Every 2026 Senate seat: holder and role, structure rating, forecaster bands where tracked, and the live Kalshi price (Democrat win probability where provable), closest race first, with a page URL per seat. Prices are never estimated — an unpriced seat returns null.

limit.description: Seats to return, closest race first, with every field (default: the 8 closest, without the forecaster detail).

tools.name: race_odds
tools.description: Use for "who wins the Kansas Senate race" and "Michigan governor odds". Live Kalshi odds for one 2026 Senate, governor or competitive House race, by state, code, slug or district ("TX-34"): every leg's price, volume and link, the seat holder and rating, forecaster bands, and the race page. Prices are never estimated.

race.description: State name or code, a race slug (kansas-senate, michigan-governor, tx-34-house), or a House district (TX-34). Omit to list the races available.

tools.name: best_price
tools.description: Use for "where is it cheapest to buy", "Kalshi or Polymarket US for the Bears game" and "cheapest venue for the Georgia Senate race". The same contract on Kalshi, Polymarket US and Novig as the cost to buy one contract including each venue's taker fee, with the cheapest named. Sports games (team, league or matchup), 2026 midterm races (state, slug or district) or the next FOMC meeting. Ranked by price only.

q.description: Free text: a team, matchup, race or "next Fed meeting".

teams.description: One or two teams, e.g. "Bears" or "NE @ CHI".

race.description: A 2026 race: state, slug (georgia-senate) or district (AZ-01).

meeting.description: Any value asks for the next FOMC meeting.

tools.name: player_outlook
tools.description: One NFL player this week — every Kalshi prop line, the best price across venues, and our probability at each strike. Free. Use for "is <player> a good play this week", "<player> props".

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Puka Nacua", "Bijan").

scoring.description: Scoring format: standard, half_ppr (default), or ppr (full PPR). Overrides a platform preset. Works for Yahoo/ESPN/Sleeper defaults. One of: standard · half_ppr · ppr.

platform.description: League platform — applies its default scoring, size, roster + best-ball settings (overridable by explicit scoring/teams). Underdog/DraftKings are best ball. One of: yahoo · espn · sleeper · nfl · cbs · fantrax · draftkings · underdog.

tools.name: explain_player
tools.description: Why our model prices an NFL player's Kalshi prop strikes where it does this week: the projection, The Ladder's verdict, the widest published gap, and what the model does not account for (our number only where calibrated, 30–70%). Use for "why do you price <player> there", "explain <player>'s prop".

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Puka Nacua").

stat.description: Optional stat to narrow to, e.g. "rec_yds", "receptions", "rush_yds".

tools.name: explain_game
tools.description: Why our model prices one NFL game where it does: Kalshi price and market line, our win probability and its anchor, the model's lean in points, each team's offense/defense/special-teams rating, the QB gate, and the published position or why none. Use for "why do you price <team> vs <team> there", "explain the <team> game line".

game.description: The matchup — two teams in any form ("Bills vs Chiefs", "BUF@KC", "Buffalo at Kansas City"), or one team for its game that week.

week.description: Optional NFL week (e.g. 6). Defaults to the current week.

tools.name: explain_prop
tools.description: Why we publish a call on one NFL player prop this week: the contract, the YES/NO call and Kalshi's price, our tier (and calibrated odds where measured), our projection vs the threshold, published or held at WATCH and why, and what the model does not account for. Use for "why do you like <player>'s over", "explain the <player> prop".

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Josh Allen").

stat.description: Optional stat, e.g. "rec_yds", "receptions", "rush_yds", "pass_tds" or "receiving yards". Defaults to the player's strongest published call.

line.description: Optional contract threshold or line (e.g. 60 or 59.5) to pick one strike.

tools.name: explain_ladder
tools.description: Why The Ladder reads one NFL strike ladder (a game spread, a season win total or a player prop) the way it does: the read in words, where Kalshi's ladder centres beside our projection, the widest published gap, and each strike with Kalshi's price and our number (30–70% only). Use for "explain the Chiefs win total ladder", "why does the ladder lean Browns".

team.description: Team code or nickname (KC, Chiefs) — its game spread ladder, or its season-win ladder with family "season_wins".

player.description: Player name, full or partial — his prop ladder.

family.description: Ladder family. Omit to take the team's spread first. One of: spread · season_wins · props.

stat.description: Prop stat for a player, e.g. "receptions" or "rec_yds". Defaults to his widest ladder.

tools.name: sleepers_and_busts
tools.description: Every NFL player whose Kalshi prop price our model disagrees with this week, ranked, marked underpriced or overpriced with the stat driving it. Free, the complete list. The strike, price and size are in Pro nfl_prop_edge. Use for "undervalued players this week", "who is the market overpricing", "sleepers this week", "busts to avoid this week".

position.description: Optional position filter. One of: QB · RB · WR · TE.
